posts.subject: Application Bhop Server
posts.bodyHtml:
Good evening Dream-Community


My name is Elroy and ingame my name is Elroy* , so that makes it easy for everyone. 😄
I come from Belgium (Antwerp) , that gives me the advantages of being able to understand a little little bit of french , dutch(ofcourse) and makes me able to understand some words when germans talk , ofcourse english aswell.
Also i'm 17 years old so i behave quite mature.
My hobbies are singing , keyboard , piano and guitar -So i could amuse you guys on teamspeak if you want it. 😄


I've been playing on your bhop server when i first started playing CS:GO (about half a year ago ,i think) and i directly loved it!!! [<3]
Also i play quite a lot on your server , you could expect me almost every day , so from monday-sunday. :p


Now at first i didn't really thought about joining this community as i never did it before on CS:GO (i was a bit scared cause i didn't know how :p)
But then a lovely player came by named Hynoxas who thought i was friendly and helpful and gave me some info about how i had to do this. (thanks btw hypno)


I have been admin before on an old game called Medal of Honor allied assault spearhead , a game from 2003.
Now i don't want to make too much attention in a bad situation between 2(or more) players , so i'm not the type of person who will start a full discussion and listen to every side of a story just to know who is the bad guy and who the good guy. IF they both are insulting then they both did something wrong , a good guy should stay mature at all time so bad words won't be needed. IF they both insult they both get warning first , then a kick if they keep on going , and then a ban for like a day(depends on how bad it went) IF there is only one bad guy who keeps going then he gets this warn-kick-ban system.
A server is meant to be fun , and nobody wants to listen how people get mad at each other. 🙂


Strenghts : I stay calm and im mature also im very patient.
Weaknesses : for example if i know a guy who insulted me on other servers or in any way(maybe private ways)and he does something wrong in the server... i probably will act agressiver then i would do with people i know are good or never did something wrong. So you could say that i don't have a straight line for everyone


Thanks for your time , thanks to hypno to help me a bit in knowing how to do this and thank you for all the fun i have on your servers.


Cya in the field!
Greetings
Elroy*

Hey you got alot of positiv Aspects like your languages but at the same time some negativ aspects like you just Registered but at all i think you got more prostiv aspects i never heard something bad about you so from me you will get an Yes

Hello @Elroy it's nice to see that you want to become a part of Dream Team Administration group I'm gonna list some cons and pros for you.


Staring with the Pros
- You're 17 so you're old enough
- Your hobbies are interesting I like the guitar especially 🙂


Moving onto the Cons
- This is your first post on forum
- I don't really see you active on the TeamSpeak. ( ts3.dream-community.de )
- You could have written your application using the Example
- I see a negative in weakness as you said "I probably will act aggressive" This is a no for me as Admins have to stay calm under any situation that is given to them
- I don't think you're mixed in well with the community just yet I would suggest waiting.



So overall I could not think anymore on pros and cons, my overall decision is a YES even tho there is more cons than pros but I see the potentials in you and I think chance is well worth a try


Kind Regards



Michal "OxygeN" J.



//EDIT: Changing opinion.

@ladog nice to meet you and thanks 🙂


@OxygeN thank for your advice , but i have been active on the teamspeak but ofcourse only on bhop channels and on a channel from hypnoxas. And with act agressiver i dont mean that i will get mad or be unpolite or anything like that, it just means that i would give faster warnings and faster kicks to that kind of person [;)]


Greetings
Elroy*

Also @OxygeN i didnt want to be unoriginal by using everything in the way the example shows you , as it says "example"... so i just tried to give answers to everything the example asked but more in my way as originality shows how a person really is [;)]

Well, where should i start.


First of all, thank you for your nice words.
I've seen you alot on the bhop server and you were also trying to help when the server had some problems in regard to the gravity and the leaderboard. In additon you stood out with your attitude to help new people on the bhop server with alot of patience and maturity. I've never heard you swearing or breaking the rules. In my opinion you are really suitable for an administrative position. Furthermore you are well known on the bhop-server.


Moving on to your application: In my opinion it's a little bit short as we dont get too many information about you. In general though you've given us the important key points in a compact form.


From my side you receive a big Yes!


PS: @OxygeN The Example is there to give a general idea of what should be answered in the application, that doesn't mean that you have to use it with the numeration.


@Elroy Double posts aren't allowed, keep that in mind for further posts. You have the possiblity to edit a post, if you want to add anything.
@Hypnoxas thanks for the feedback 🙂 And sorry for the double post i didnt know this rule , i'll edit it next time i forget something in a post 🙂
I understand that but I would rather see the exampled being used it looks more neat but Good luck in your application hope you pass as I see you are postively set

In the first place I don't see a need for an admin on the shop server. The worst thing that could happen is some random guy playing music using the voice chat. But then lol could just get rid of the problem themselves by muting him.
I also don't see people arguing on the bhop server as there is no real way they may start a fight that isn't about rtv-ing the map.
There has also been a testadmin on the former skillsurf server who had to later on "manage" another server (jail in that case) because there weren't really any chances they could have proven their skills as an admin.



Tl;dr
There's no need for bhop admin imo.
Maybe apply for another server?

@Pixel its indeed true that there aren't a lot of troubles in the bhop server , as you said there are sometimes some rtv arguments and sometimes some voicespam , also some people dont care about the rule of German and English only. But having an admin around is always a good thing imo , it offers a bit of safety to everyone for IF something would go wrong. It wouldn't be the first time someone rtv's the whole time just to annoy others.
Also i'm very active on bhop server and waaaay less then on any of your other servers, i do like them but i just like bhopping a lot. So thats why i only wanna apply for the bhop server 🙂
I giv yu a YES
He is a nice man and he is friendly i give u a YES

Overall, I give you a YES
